Class InferenceTest

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.tp.InferenceTest
public class InferenceTest extends Object
Represents a single .tq inference test, including metadata, assertions, expected answers, and results.

    • runTest

      public void runTest(KB kb, String proverType)
      Runs this test using its meta-predicate options.
      Parameters:
      kb - knowledge base used for the test.
      proverType - prover to use.
      closedWorldAssumption - whether to use the closed world assumption.
      modusPonens - whether to enable modus ponens.
      dropOnePremise - whether to drop one premise during inference.
      holUseModals - whether HOL modal translation is enabled.

    • runTest

      public void runTest(KB kb, String proverType, String language, String vampireMode, boolean closedWorldAssumption, boolean modusPonens, boolean dropOnePremise, boolean holUseModals, int timeout, int maxAnswers)
      Runs this test overriding the meta-predicate options.
      Parameters:
      kb - knowledge base used for the test.
      proverType - prover to use.
      language - target logical language.
      vampireMode - Vampire execution mode.
      closedWorldAssumption - whether to use the closed world assumption.
      modusPonens - whether to enable modus ponens.
      dropOnePremise - whether to drop one premise during inference.
      holUseModals - whether HOL modal translation is enabled.
      timeout - prover timeout in seconds.
      maxAnswers - maximum number of answers to return.
